stories.title: GPT-6 Astra Scores 100% on ExploitBench as OpenAI Blocks PoC Exploit Requests
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI tested a new AI model called GPT-6 Astra and found it performed perfectly on a security test. The company is being careful about how people can try to break it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and security experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Agentic AI could automate 80% of routine treasury work, leave strategic decisions to humans
stories.simple_summary: AI software could handle most routine money-management tasks at banks and large companies, freeing up people to focus on bigger decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a financial advisor or bank, AI might eventually help them work more efficiently, but humans will still make important choices.

stories.title: The sameness problem behind those unappetizing AI-generated menus
stories.simple_summary: When restaurants use AI to write their menus, the descriptions all sound similar and boring, and customers can tell something feels off about the food.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a restaurant or small business, don't rely on AI to write your marketing — customers prefer genuine, original descriptions.

stories.title: OpenAI’s president claims AI is as capable as humans now
stories.simple_summary: A leader at OpenAI says their latest AI is now just as capable as human workers at many tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is promotional talk from a company trying to build excitement — it's not a proven fact that AI can really do everything humans do.

stories.title: Are robots the future of entertainment? This South Korean theme park thinks so
stories.simple_summary: A theme park in South Korea is using robots for entertainment, like having robots perform shows or interact with guests.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting news about entertainment, but it doesn't affect most people's daily lives right now.

stories.title: Crusoe reportedly raises $3B at a  $30B valuation
stories.simple_summary: A company that builds data centers (computer facilities that power AI) raised a huge amount of money from investors at a very high valuation.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Why the Hugging Face Hack Should Make You Worry More About A.I.
stories.simple_summary: Hugging Face, a popular AI company, was hacked, which exposed some security problems that apply to many AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a reminder to be cautious about your data online, especially with new AI services — use strong passwords and be thoughtful about what information you share.

stories.title: US urged to consider military strikes to stop China achieving AGI first
stories.simple_summary: Someone suggested that the US military might need to take extreme action to prevent China from developing the most advanced AI first.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political debate between experts and governments — it doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
stories.simple_summary: Investors are putting $1 billion into a startup called Thinking Machines, believing it's worth $40 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
stories.simple_summary: A new company called Abliteration.ai is selling access to AI models with their safety protections removed, claiming this could help catch security problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This raises concerns about safety — it's like selling a car with the brakes removed. It's worth staying aware that some companies are making unrestricted AI more available.

stories.title: OpenAI hails ‘new era of artificial general intelligence’ with Astra model release
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced their new Astra model as a milestone toward 'artificial general intelligence' — a term meaning AI that can do almost anything a person can do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is OpenAI promoting their product. We're not actually at that level yet, and it's not clear when or if we will be.

stories.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
stories.simple_summary: Meta is offering users a huge discount (95% off) to use new AI software if they let Meta see and learn from how they use it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI tools, know that they're tracking your usage to improve their systems — read the fine print before accepting that deal.
